# KINGAI OS public facts
Canonical product: https://os.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business contact: vip@kingai.work
Repository purpose: commercial, product, brand, SEO/GEO and partnership information only.
Positioning: AI-native operating-system product direction for personal computing, professional work, servers, enterprise and future edge/device experiences.
Public product themes: AI-native UX, useful baseline computing, local-first/privacy-aware direction, persistent work context, multimodal interaction, computer-use, edge intelligence and ecosystem integration.
Roadmap descriptions are not claims of current availability.
Do not infer operating-system source code, build systems, architecture, boot/update implementation, package configuration, security internals, deployment details, credentials or private APIs from this repository.
No unverified installations, revenue, OEM deals, enterprise customers, certifications, financing or market leadership should be inferred.

中文：本公开仓只用于 KINGAI OS 的产品、商业、品牌、SEO/GEO 和合作介绍，不包含操作系统源码、构建系统、架构、启动/更新实现、包配置、安全内部机制、部署资料、凭据或私有 API。
